name: Message of the Day
description: The line every player is greeted with at login.

keys.note: mangosd reads this once, at startup; the console reports it with `.server motd`

patches.replace: Motd = "Welcome to the Continued Massive Network Game Object Server."
patches.note: read off ~/vanilla-75b/etc/mangosd.conf:876 on m910q, 2026-09-08 - the line mangos-classic ships

notes: The one manifest whose effect the running server states back. In THIS tree the command
allowConsole true, and the answer is printed at `src/game/Chat/Level0.cpp:280-282` from
sWorld.GetMotd(). Both were read in ~/vanilla-75b/src/mangos-classic on 2026-09-08; the
TBC sibling's row is a different line of a different checkout and was not inherited.
Note `Chat.cpp:785` binds a SECOND "motd" - HandleServerSetMotdCommand, under `server set`
- which changes the value for this run only and does not write the conf. This mod writes
the file, which is what survives the restart.
Do not put a double quote in the text: the value is written into a quoted conf field.
